notes: «وَ مِنْهُ» («and from him») opens with a back reference and no previous report is supplied: written as it stands, nothing inherited
«حدثني محمد بن الحسن» and «حدثني محمد بن الحسن الصفار» are two men, each with its own «حدثني»: two links
«عن أخيه» names no one: relation; «عن أبيه سيف بن عميرة» is one link, the name alone (rule 7)
the Imam «أبي عبد الله» sits inside the chain after «عن»: narrator (owner ruling 2)
